title: Air Liquide expects Qatar restart to ease helium supply pressures
supports: QatarEnergy has partially restarted its Helium 2 plant; volumes undisclosed; industry experts put output below ~30% of normal capacity; Air Liquide expects reduced shortage impact in H2 2026 (via search snippet; resp-lean-array-module WebSearch 1/3, query: Qatar helium production restart Ras Laffan 2026). Used for RT-IND-lean-array-module-04.

title: Qatar to resume LNG production within weeks, says Prime Minister
supports: PM (June 24, 2026): LNG output back to normal within weeks except damaged facilities; full ramp depends on Strait of Hormuz navigation; two of 14 LNG trains damaged, repairs 3-5 years (via search snippet; WebSearch 1/3). Helium is an LNG by-product, so ~17% of Qatar capacity stays out for years.

title: Qatari LNG shutdown puts 11% of global helium supply at risk
supports: Qatar ~30% of world helium capacity; ~30% of Qatar volumes could be lost in 2026, ~11% of global supply (via search snippet; WebSearch 1/3).

title: Measurement and modeling of hydrogen molecule ro-vibrational accommodation on E-294 graphite (Plasma Phys. Control. Fusion 50, 102001)
supports: Rotational accommodation of H2 and D2 on graphite ~0.05-0.2, vibrational ~0.01-0.2, rising slightly with surface temperature; MD gives total ro-vibrational ~0.1 (via search snippet; resp-lean-array-module WebSearch 2/3, query: thermal accommodation coefficient hydrogen H2 measured surface rotational accommodation). Supports RT-DEV-lean-array-module-01: rotational/translational ratio r ~0.1-0.4, so the effective a_H2 prior falls to ~0.19-0.21.

title: EPS 2008 plasma physics conference P2.004 (H2 ro-vibrational accommodation follow-up)
supports: Same trend: accommodation of H2 internal modes rises slightly with surface temperature; measured rovibrational coefficients low (partial text via search snippet; WebSearch 2/3).

title: Phys. Rev. 40, 78 (1932): thermal accommodation of hydrogen on tungsten
supports: Re-confirmed: H2 on W 0.537 bare, 0.143 with adsorbed H film; oxygen contamination lowers it further (via search snippet; WebSearch 2/3). Shows adsorbates can move a_H2 across GO/NO-GO; motivates plasma-pretreated coupons (RT-DEV-04) and cryo matrix (RT-PROC-04).

title: Cryogenic Etch: A Key Enabler Of 3D NAND
supports: TEL: HF gas greatly reduces the partial pressure of conventional CF gas (lower carbon footprint); a small amount of PF3 catalyses HF-SiO2 reaction for fast low-temperature etch; Lam has ~1,000 cryo chambers in 3D NAND production (via search snippet; resp-lean-array-module WebSearch 3/3, query: cryogenic etch HF channel hole fluorocarbon-free TEL Lam Cryo PFAS). Used for RT-PROC-02 revival path (deep etches of portfolio 3D cells) and RT-PROC-04 (cryo chucks at about -60 C).

title: Yunogami nanofocus 89-1: helium procurement halt (EE Times Japan, April 2026)
supports: Describes TEL 'HF/PF3 + Cryo' channel-hole etch at about -60 C with very little sidewall polymer; Lam later pursued a similar approach (via search snippet; WebSearch 3/3). The same article series addresses helium procurement risk for chipmaking.

title: US 11,075,084 - Chemistries for etching multi-stacked layers
supports: Hydrofluorocarbon etch gases for multi-stacked layers with high selectivity; shows the deep-etch alternatives in the patent record are still fluorinated carbon chemistries, not PFAS-free (via search snippet; WebSearch 3/3). Supports RT-PROC-02/RT-CIRC-04 downgrade.
